part.text:
The robot is now standing in front of the green panel at the end of the corridor. The camera shows the panel filling the view. I called rest, so the robot has crouched and its motors are off.

The corridor had several bends, and the robot never fell. The sonar read about 0.86 m to the panel on the last step, and the robot stopped a bit closer than that, so I'd estimate it's within about 0.5 m of the panel.
